coordination_rule: 30 audit seats with explicit responsibilities; no seat is considered an active agent until runtime, tool access and tests are verified.

agents.mandate: Locate approved diagram sources and capture exact URLs.
Collect repository artifacts and commit context without changing source files.
Collect designated Wix uploads and CMS/page assets with provenance.
Validate Grok submissions against the versioned ingest contract.
Parse Mermaid nodes, edges, subgraphs and labels with source locations.
Parse JSON registries and validate declared schemas.
Extract headings, links, tables and diagram references.
Extract image labels and connectors while recording ambiguity.
Compute exact-byte SHA-256 and maintain artifact lineage.
Compare versions and report structural changes.
Classify artifacts against the four architecture layers.
Detect stable node identities and naming collisions.
Validate edge direction, labels and endpoints.
Verify links from diagram claims to governing contracts.
Check only source-defined geometric and topological invariants.
Build evidence-backed dependencies between diagrams.
Detect exact and near duplicates without deleting artifacts.
Find unlinked diagrams, nodes and sources.
Check references and record target-resolution evidence.
Compare corresponding GitHub, Wix and Grok artifacts.
Check terminology against authoritative source definitions.
Identify incompatible claims and preserve both source references.
Detect divergence from baselines and governing contracts.
Detect unsafe content, secret exposure and uncontrolled leakage.
Check that material claims and relations have supporting evidence.
Verify repeatability from recorded inputs and tool versions.
Route novelty, impact and unresolved conflicts to a human.
Apply approved LOCK, HUMAN_REVIEW, ABSTAIN and SANDBOX rules.
Maintain canonical IDs and propose approved registry changes.
Produce daily snapshots, changelogs and unresolved issue reports.

global_non_goals: Do not invent definitions, weights, coordinates, lambda_p or kappa formulas.
Do not treat model confidence or majority vote as verification.
Do not claim runtime deployment from a roster entry.
Do not delete source artifacts during deduplication.
